name: Ethiglo Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ETHIGLO TABLET

Ethiglo Tablet is a health supplement used for skin whitening and lightening. It is also used to manage skin problems such as hyperpigmentation, age spots, dark spots and uneven skin tone. It contains L glutathione, pine bark extract, vitamin C, alpha lipoic acid and grape seed extract as active ingredients that helps in skin brightening and lightening.

Glutathione exhibits antioxidant and anti-melanogenic activity, thereby imparting enormous glow and brightness to the skin, eliminating the signs of aging. Vitamin C acts as a strong antioxidant by neutralizing the free radicals and promotes the collagen synthesis in skin, thereby fastening the cell turnover rate of the skin. Pine bark extract tends to manage skin ageing due to exposure to sun rays. Alpha lipoic acid and grapeseed extract protect the skin cells by showing antioxidant behaviour.

Always take Ethiglo Tablet as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Recommended dosage is one tablet a day after meals. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to any of its components.
author: Dr. R. Dinesh John Rajkumar

name: Tendofit Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About TENDOFIT TABLET

Tendofit Tablet is a nutritional supplement used as a supportive management for tendinopathies such as frozen shoulder, plantar fasciitis and achilles tendinopathy. It contains collagen peptides type I, sodium hyaluronate, chondroitin sulfate and vitamin C as active ingredients to support tendon regeneration.

Collagen peptide is the main building protein found in bones, skin, cartilage and other connective tissues. Chondroitin sulfate makes up the matrix in the joints and manages the breakdown of collagen. Sodium hyaluronate along with chondroitin sulfate reduces the inflammation associated with joint problems. Also, sodium hyaluronate acts as a lubricant to manage friction or abrasion. Vitamin C aids in the synthesis of collagen in the body and possesses antioxidant properties.

Always take Tendofit Tablet as advised by the doctor. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Recommended dosage is one tablet thrice daily or as directed by the doctor. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to any of its components.
author: Dr. R. Dinesh John Rajkumar

name: Normoz Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NORMOZ TABLET

Normoz Tablet is a dietary supplement that is used to manage Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS), irregular periods, pregnancy/conceiving issues, and weight issues in women. It contains Myo-Inositol, D-Chiro Inositol, Chromium Picolinate, and Vitamin D3 as active ingredients which help in managing the problems associated with PCOS in women.

Myo-Inositol, D-Chiro helps in improving ovarian function, ovulation, and insulin action in women with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS). Chromium Picolinate enhances insulin action that is required for metabolism and storage of carbohydrate, fat, and protein in the body, thereby helping in regulating body weight. Vitamin D2 helps the body in enhancing calcium absorption, thereby increasing bone density, and decreasing bone fragility.

Always take Normoz Tablet as advised by your physician. Take one tablet daily. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water, do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions while taking it.

Ginkocer Plus Tablet is a dietary supplement used to manage vitamin, mineral and nutritional deficiencies. It contains vitamins, minerals, gingko biloba, L-arginine and N-acetyl L-cysteine as active ingredients that help restore a variety of essential vitamins and minerals in the body and improve general health.

Ginkgo biloba contains potent antioxidants which fight the damaging effects of free radicals. Vitamin D is needed for healthy bones and teeth. Vitamin A is essential for night vision and a healthy skin. Vitamin E protects your cells from radical damage.

Vitamin C helps tissue and bone grow and repair themselves. L-arginine is an amino acid that widens blood vessels for better blood flow. Zinc aids in growth and maintenance of muscles and magnesium in normal bone structure. N-acetyl L-cysteine is an amino acid which are building blocks of proteins.

Take Ginkocer Plus Tablet as advised by your doctor. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose. Consult your doctor before taking it during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

introduction:
Introduction About ARGIPREG SACHET

Argipreg Sachet Sugar-Free (Improved Flavour) is a health supplement designed to support healthy blood flow and circulation throughout the body by widening narrowed blood vessels. It is especially beneficial for individuals with heart conditions, high blood pressure, or pregnancy-related concerns such as pre-eclampsia (high BP during pregnancy) and intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR), where the baby is smaller than expected for the gestational age.

It contains L-arginine, a non-essential amino acid, and Proanthocyanidin, a powerful antioxidant derived from grape seed extract. These ingredients work together to promote better blood flow and strengthen blood vessels.

L-arginine helps widen blood vessels, improving blood flow to the heart, placenta, and other vital organs.
Proanthocyanidin, a natural antioxidant found in fruits and vegetables, supports blood vessel health, especially in people with hypertension or diabetes, helping prevent future heart problems and strokes.

This sugar-free formula with improved flavor makes it a convenient and health-conscious choice for daily use.

mechanismOfAction:
How ARGIPREG SACHET Works

Argipreg Sachet Sugar-Free works by improving blood flow and keeping your blood vessels healthy. It contains two key ingredients – L-arginine and Proanthocyanidin (from grape seed extract).

L-arginine helps your body produce nitric oxide, a natural substance that relaxes and widens blood vessels. This makes it easier for blood to flow smoothly, helping lower high blood pressure and ensuring enough oxygen and nutrients reach important organs like the heart and placenta during pregnancy.
Proanthocyanidin is a powerful antioxidant that protects blood vessels from damage. It also supports circulation, especially in people with high blood pressure, diabetes, or pregnancy-related issues like pre-eclampsia and IUGR (where the baby is smaller than expected).

By working together, these ingredients help improve blood circulation, support heart and pregnancy health, and reduce the risk of complications like heart problems or poor fetal growth.

usageDetails:
How to use ARGIPREG SACHET
Argipreg Sachet Mixing Instructions:

Empty the contents of one Argipreg Sachet Sugar-Free into a glass containing approximately 100 ml of water. Stir well until fully dissolved. Drink the solution immediately for best results.

Argipreg Sachet – With or Without Food:

Argipreg Sachet can be taken with or without food, based on your comfort. If you experience mild stomach upset, try taking it after meals.

Recommended Dosage and Timing for Argipreg Sachet:

Take one sachet once or twice daily, or as directed by your doctor. The dosage may vary depending on your health condition—especially during pregnancy, hypertension, or heart-related issues.

Best Time to Consume Argipreg Sachet:

For best absorption and effectiveness, take Argipreg:

In the morning on an empty stomach, or
After meals if advised by your doctor

Always follow your doctor's advice regarding the exact timing and duration of use, especially during pregnancy or if you have existing medical conditions.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ARGIPREG SACHET

Argipreg Sachet Sugar-Free is generally well tolerated when taken as advised by your doctor. However, like all supplements, some people may experience mild side effects, especially during the initial days of use.

Common Side Effects of ARGIPREG SACHET:
Mild stomach discomfort or bloating
Nausea or a feeling of fullness
Headache in rare cases
Loose stools if taken in high doses

These side effects are usually temporary and go away on their own as your body adjusts to the supplement.

When To Seek Medical Attention?

You should contact your doctor or seek medical help immediately if you experience:

Severe stomach pain or vomiting
Shortness of breath or chest tightness
Signs of an allergic reaction such as rash, itching, swelling, or difficulty breathing
Persistent headaches or dizziness

Always inform your doctor about any side effects you experience, especially if you are pregnant, have heart disease, or are on other medications.

warnings.details: Argipreg Sachet is often prescribed during pregnancy to improve placental blood flow, especially in conditions like pre-eclampsia or IUGR. However, it should only be used under medical supervision. Always follow your doctor’s dosage instructions during pregnancy.
There is limited data on the use of Argipreg during breastfeeding. Consult your doctor before using it while nursing to ensure it is safe for both you and your baby.
Argipreg is unlikely to affect your ability to drive or operate machinery. However, if you experience dizziness or light-headedness, avoid such activities until you feel better.
People with kidney disorders or history of kidney stones should consult a doctor before using Argipreg, as L-arginine may affect kidney function in high doses.
If you have liver problems, consult your doctor before taking Argipreg. While it is generally safe, dosage adjustments may be necessary depending on liver function.

Avoid Argipreg if you are allergic to L-arginine, grape seed extract (Proanthocyanidin), or any other ingredients in the sachet. Seek immediate medical attention if you develop rash, swelling, or difficulty breathing.

Argipreg may benefit lung function by improving oxygen delivery through better circulation. However, people with chronic respiratory conditions like asthma or COPD should use it only under medical advice.

Argipreg may help individuals with heart disease by improving blood flow and supporting vascular health. However, patients with a history of heart attacks, angina, or heart failure should use it under close medical supervision.
Argipreg is not commonly recommended for children unless specifically prescribed by a pediatrician for certain conditions. Always follow your doctor’s instructions.

Older adults can benefit from Argipreg for improving circulation, blood pressure, and heart health, but they should use it cautiously, especially if taking other medications. Dose adjustment may be needed based on kidney or liver function.

Introduction About CORCAL (NU) 500MG TABLET

Nu Corcal 500mg Tablet is a calcium supplement used to manage low calcium levels, muscle cramps, osteoporosis, softening of the bones, and pre-menstrual syndrome. It contains calcium and curcuma longa as active ingredients that help manage or manage low blood calcium levels.

Calcium is necessary for the normal functioning of nerves, cells, muscles, and bone. If there is not enough calcium in the blood, then the body will take calcium from bones, and weaken them. Having the right amount of calcium is essential for building and keeping strong bones. Curcuma longa possesses anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.

Take Nu Corcal 500mg Tablet exactly as advised by the doctor. Inform your doctor if you have high calcium levels, achlorhydria (low acid levels in the stomach), kidney problems or if you smoke. Ask your doctor before taking it during pregnancy or lactation.

name: Meloset 3mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MELOSET 3MG TABLET

MELOSET 3MG TABLET contains Melatonin which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormones. It is used to manage jetlag in adults. Jet-lag can be recognized by sleep disturbances, daytime tiredness, fatigue, mild mental impairment, irritability and digestive system disturbances experienced after flying.           

Avoid smoking as it may reduce the effect of this medicine and alcohol consumption while taking MELOSET 3MG TABLET as it can impair sleep and potentially worsen certain symptoms of jetlag (Ex. headache, morning fatigue and concentration).            

MELOSET 3MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with impaired liver or kidney function, epilepsy, autoimmune disease (where the body is attacked by its own immune system), diabetes or impaired glucose tolerance. Consult your doctor before taking it.     

MELOSET 3MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and women of childbearing potential must use effective contraception. MELOSET 3MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.     

MELOSET 3MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. MELOSET 3MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking it.    

The most common side effects of taking MELOSET 3MG TABLET are headache and drowsiness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens or persist for a long period of time.

Uses Of MELOSET 3MG TABLET
Manage jet-lag in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How MELOSET 3MG TABLET Works

MELOSET 3MG TABLET helps to restore the normal day-and-night rhythm by synchronizing the body’s biological day-and-night rhythm as disturbances in biological rhythm may cause sleep disturbances, daytime tiredness, fatigue, mild mental impairment, irritability and other symptoms. Thus MELOSET 3MG TABLET helps to restore the normal day-and-night rhythm and reduce the symptoms.

Take MELOSET 3MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the whole medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the medicine depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking MELOSET 3MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of following medicines:

Fluvoxamine (used to manage of depression and obsessive-compulsive disorder)
Psoralens (used for managing skin disorders like psoriasis)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach problems such as ulcers)
Estrogens (used as contraceptives or hormone replacement preparations)
Quinolones, rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Carbamazepine (used to manage epilepsy)
Benzodiazepines and non-benzodiazepine hypnotics (medicines that induce sleep, Ex. midazolam, temazepam, zaleplon, zolpidem and zopiclone)
Warfarin (used to manage or manage blood clots)

B. Drug-Food Interactions:

Food should not be consumed 2 hours before or 2 hours after taking MELOSET 3MG TABLET.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of MELOSET 3MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage includes drowsiness, headache, dizziness and nausea.
